title: RAGCompass: Generalizable Retriever Routing via Reranking
abstract: arXiv:2611.05596v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Different retrievers exist for retrieval-augmented generation, yet none performs best for all queries. Therefore, the key question is: given a query and retrieved passages from different retrievers, which one is most suited for that query? Existing routers usually make predictions from query-specific features and a fixed pool of retrievers; such routers have no output for an unseen retriever and are incapable by design on a new corpus. To fill these gaps, RAGCompass reads the retrieved passage sets themselves: passages from an unfamiliar retriever or corpus stay directly comparable to other passages, so routing stays well designed where a query-only map would fail. We contrastively fine-tune a reranker against the answer each evidence set produces, which accounts for most of the gain; a small comparison head adds a moderate improvement, and neither component has retriever-specific parameters. RAGCompass improves answer F1 by 28% relative

translated_title: RAGCompass：通过重排序实现可泛化的检索器路由
translated_abstract: 在检索增强生成（RAG）中存在多种不同的检索器，但没有一种检索器能在所有查询上都表现最佳。因此，关键问题是：给定一个查询以及不同检索器检索到的段落，哪一种最适合该查询？现有的路由器通常基于查询特定特征和固定的检索器池进行预测；这类路由器对于未见过的检索器无法给出输出，且在设计上天生无法应对新语料库。为填补这些空白，RAGCompass 直接读取检索到的段落集合本身：来自陌生检索器或新语料库的段落仍可与其他段落直接比较，因此在仅依赖查询特征的路由会失效的场景下，路由依然有效。我们针对每个证据集所产生的答案，对重排序器进行对比微调，这贡献了绝大部分性能提升；一个小型的比较模块带来了适度的额外改进，且这两个组件都不包含检索器专属参数。RAGCompass 将答案 F1 相对提升了 28%
tldr: RAGCompass 通过对比微调重排序器直接读取不同检索器返回的段落集合来实现查询路由，从而可泛化到未见过的检索器和新语料库，将答案 F1 相对提升 28%。
en_tdlr: RAGCompass routes queries to the most suitable retriever by reading the retrieved passage sets with a contrastively fine-tuned reranker, generalizing to unseen retrievers and new corpora and improving answer F1 by 28%.
